extraction.title: Bea Borres reacts to criticism over video reunion with ex-boyfriend Meray Yamada
extraction.description: Bea Borres defends vlogging with ex Meray Yamada, notes she doesn't promote online gambling.
extraction.text: Content creator Bea Borres breaks her silence amid the mixed reactions to her reunion with her ex-boyfriend Meray Yamada. Recently, the celebrity mom met up with Meray for what she jokingly described as a "clout-chasing" move for her vlog. Bea also playfully said that reuniting with her ex would help her earn money for their daughter, Victoria Hope. Despite their apparent boundaries, however, some fans still felt the kilig vibes between the former couple. Others, including Bea's close friend Andrea Brillantes, disagreed with the netizens' excitement over the ex-couple. READ: Andrea Brillantes on Bea Borres-Meray Yamada ship: 'Lahat kayo kinikilig, pwes ako hindi' Amid the reactions, Bea shared her thoughts on the hate comments circulating online. "Why are you guys mad at me!," she wrote. "Atleast I'm not accepting online sugal 😒 Mag clout chase nalang ako 😒 It's my content, just block me nalang if you think i'm tanga!!!!" The influencer also added in the comments, "If I promote sugal diba you'll bash me rin naman, go kanya-kanya na 'tong hustle." The following day, Bea Borres continued sharing content featuring Meray. Titled "Gatasan Serye," the new video showed Bea and Baby Hopea watching Meray play basketball. The influencer noted how much her daughter enjoyed cheering for her dad, while she continued to maintain her playful distance from her ex. Despite their recent posts together, Bea previously clarified in their vlog that she and Meray will not be co-parenting as a couple. READ: Bea Borres not worried taking on responsibility as a single parent Bea Borres previously revealed that they had broken up before she publicly announced her pregnancy last year. She gave birth to Hopea on December 15, 2025, and brought her daughter home in January after a 44-day stay in the NICU. Get to know Bea Borres's ex-boyfriend, Meray Yamada, in this gallery.
